themeWorkbench.noneDescription: Use Mermaid configuration and source styles.
themeWorkbench.swatchHint: Illustrative swatches. Design scope does not certify output support or portability.
themeWorkbench.visualHint: Edits preserve other fields. Advanced paints, resources, effects and typography remain available in JSON.
themeWorkbench.fontStack: Font stack, one family per line
themeWorkbench.canvasHint: Canvas layers and bleed stay intact. Preview backing is a separate display preference.
themeWorkbench.precedence: Later rules can replace earlier facets on the same target. Family filters are explicit scopes. Mermaid configuration and source styles can also affect the result; this editor does not infer per-field provenance.
themeWorkbench.ruleOrder: Authored order; later rules take precedence
themeWorkbench.advancedRule: Edit this target in JSON. Its authored rule is preserved.
themeWorkbench.palettePreserved: Ordinal palettes remain intact and can be edited in JSON.
themeWorkbench.supportHint: Declared capabilities are separate from the current render outcome and output portability. Unknown results stay unverified.
themeWorkbench.unknownFamily: A diagram family is needed to query support.
themeWorkbench.validRecipeRequired: Fix the recipe before exporting it.
themeWorkbench.noRecipe: Choose Customize or create a new theme first.
themeWorkbench.title: Theme workbench
themeWorkbench.invalidDraft: Invalid draft · showing last valid theme
themeWorkbench.unknownPreset: Selected preset {{id}} is unavailable in this catalog. Its selection is preserved.
themeWorkbench.compatibilityHint: This workspace setting affects both engines. Merman recipes and source styles can override parts of it.
themeWorkbench.fixJson: Fix the JSON recipe to use Visual controls. The last valid theme remains in the preview.
themeWorkbench.customizeHint: Customize the selected preset or create a new theme to edit its recipe.
themeWorkbench.discardDescription: This replaces your unapplied theme draft. Source, font and configuration edits are kept.
themeWorkbench.applyFirst: Apply the theme draft before sharing or exporting the preview.
themeWorkbench.invalidPreview: Invalid JSON. Preview uses the last valid theme with the current diagram.
themeWorkbench.evidenceUnavailable: No execution evidence is available for this SVG.
themeWorkbench.evidenceUnknown: This renderer returned an unknown evidence version. Details are preserved below.
themeWorkbench.evidenceExplanation: These results describe this SVG execution. Preset design scope and runtime support are separate; an empty diagnostic list does not certify portability.
themeWorkbench.compareStyled: Merman applies its selected preset or custom recipe. Mermaid.js receives the Mermaid source and config. Choose None in the theme workbench for a comparison without Merman styling.

bench.title: Browser Benchmark
bench.description: Balanced Merman and Mermaid measurements in isolated browser runtimes. Fresh runtime samples may reuse the HTTP cache; cache observations are reported separately.
bench.realmColdDescription: Each measured sample rebuilds a separate iframe and module state. The primary result uses one parent clock from sample dispatch through strict SVG validation; bootstrap and HTTP cache observations remain separate.
bench.warmDescription: Each engine keeps its own isolated iframe, receives the same number of real-source warmups, then is measured repeatedly to the same strict parent-side SVG boundary.
bench.cancelledShowingPrevious: The latest run was cancelled. Showing the previous result.
bench.staleDescription: This run keeps its frozen source and options. Current editor changes will render after the benchmark releases the live coordinator.
bench.preparing: Pausing live rendering and preparing isolated runtimes
bench.setupEvidenceDescription: Parent-clock artifact acquisition and isolated-runtime bootstrap finish before the isolated-runtime sample clock. They are retained separately and are not presented as network-cold evidence.
bench.rawEvidenceDescription: Failed and warmup samples remain inspectable here and in the downloaded report; they never enter measured aggregates.
bench.noSamples: No sample completed before the terminal event.
bench.failureEvidenceDescription: Each failure remains attributed to the engine and stage that produced it.

metricDescriptions.firstPublishableSvgMs: One parent clock from dispatch to a fresh isolated runtime through response-envelope checks and the same strict SVG projector used by the Playground.
metricDescriptions.warmPublishableSvgMs: One parent clock from dispatch to a reused isolated runtime through response-envelope checks and the same strict SVG projector used by the Playground.

examples.title: Example Gallery
examples.description: Select an example to load into the editor
examples.searchPlaceholder: Search title, type, alias, or source
examples.empty: No examples match the current filters.

hover.flowchart: Declares a flowchart. Common directions are TD, LR, BT, and RL.
hover.graph: Alternative flowchart header used by Mermaid.
hover.sequenceDiagram: Declares a sequence diagram for message flows between participants.
hover.classDiagram: Declares a class diagram with classes, members, and relationships.
hover.stateDiagram: Declares a state diagram using the v2 state syntax.
hover.journey: Declares a user journey diagram with sections, tasks, scores, and actors.
hover.info: Declares an info diagram for Mermaid runtime/version information.
hover.zenuml: Declares a ZenUML diagram with family-owned grammar and typed headless rendering.
hover.xychart: Declares an XY chart with x-axis, y-axis, bar, and line series.
hover.architecture: Declares an architecture diagram with groups, services, and edges.
hover.c4: Declares a C4 diagram such as C4Context or C4Container.
hover.block: Declares a block diagram with grid columns and block relationships.
hover.packet: Declares a packet diagram where each row describes a bit field.
hover.kanban: Declares a kanban board with columns and item metadata.
hover.quadrant: Declares a quadrant chart with axis labels, quadrants, and points.
hover.sankey: Declares a Sankey diagram using source,target,value rows.
hover.radar: Declares a radar chart with axes and curves.
hover.treemap: Declares a treemap using indentation to represent hierarchy.
hover.requirement: Declares a requirement diagram. Avoid commas in unquoted text fields.
hover.eventmodeling: Declares an Event Modeling diagram with timeframes, reset frames, and event streams.
hover.subgraph: Starts a flowchart subgraph. Close it with end.

svgPipelineDescriptions.readable: Adds SVG text for consumers that ignore HTML labels. May show duplicate text in browsers.

svgPipelineGuidance.browserWarning: Text fallback SVG keeps HTML labels and adds SVG text. Both can appear in this browser preview and overlap.

customTheme.title: Custom Merman theme
customTheme.description: Edit a theme recipe, start from a preset, or import a JSON file. Your diagram changes only after validation succeeds.
customTheme.help: A versioned recipe contains a definition (tokens and styles) or a complete_spec. Workspace links include the applied recipe.
customTheme.limitations: Alpha format: future releases may require migration. Fonts must be available on the receiving device. Styling support varies by diagram family and output; validation does not certify every export.
customTheme.tooLarge: Theme JSON must be {{limit}} KiB or smaller.
customTheme.unchanged: The applied theme has not changed.
